title: Half-year revenue, set next to the compute already promised
intro: Fortune’s account of Anthropic’s S-1 puts first-half revenue at $16.28 billion, up 1,300%. About $13.1 billion of that, roughly 80%, is usage customers can cut. Compute commitments are at least $475 billion. Switch between those reported figures.
note: Revenue and the usage split are for the first half. The 1,300% is the rise Fortune reports for that half. Compute is a commitment, not cash already spent, and “at least $475 billion” is the floor in the same article. This block does not divide one figure by the other.

sources.label: Fortune: Anthropic’s S-1 makes clear it’s on the hook for billions in compute. Its customers can walk at any time, 26 October 2026
